data.one_liner: Optimize Flutter web page loading and browser cache issues by splitting files and hashing resources.
data.what_it_does: It provides optimization tools for Flutter web projects via command line. It splits large files, hashes resource files for CDN use, and solves browser caching problems.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application and want to improve slow page load times.
You need to handle browser caching issues for web assets using content hashing.
You want to upload optimized web resources to a CDN or file server using custom or template plugins.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile-only or desktop-only native app without a Flutter web target.
You do not use command-line build optimization workflows.
strengths: Solves slow web page loading and browser cache issues out of the box.
Supports splitting large files and generating hashed resource files.
Provides custom plugin support to automatically upload files to remote servers like Tencent COS or Alibaba OSS.
weaknesses: No predefined alternatives in the catalog that provide the exact same web optimization toolset.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_web_optimizer to dev_dependencies and run optimization commands via the terminal.
data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  flutter_web_optimizer: ^1.5.1

# Run command:
# flutter pub run flutter_web_optimizer optimize --asset-base http://your-cdn-url/
